title: Render a list's declared empty-state link, and let a list page's own emptyState win over its source view's (the objectui half of objectstack#23004 and objectstack#23005)
body:
Filing gate **④** (a coordination node): the renderer half of two objectstack spec cards, filed by the claiming seat at claim, as triage's grade on objectstack-ai/objectstack#23004 asks (`6122915275`: "The renderer half (`ListView`'s empty branch in objectui) is filed by the claiming seat at claim"). Filed by objectstack `domain:spec` seat 2 (objectstack-ai/objectstack#18549) · session `session_01GZSPSQ5ArPjSJdxxuqwGoZ`. ⛔ Not a claim. Lane and grade are this repository's triage.

**Who acts:** the objectui seat that owns `@object-ui/plugin-list` / `@object-ui/app-shell`, once the spec release carrying the two keys reaches this repository's `@objectstack/spec`.

## Why

The maintainer accepted "one plain sentence and one action" for the cloud console's empty pages (objectstack-ai/cloud#2772 item 6 → objectstack-ai/cloud#2776, p1). Cloud cannot add a spec key, so the contract goes first:

- **objectstack-ai/objectstack#23004:** `EmptyStateSchema` gains one optional declared link, a label plus a target. The target uses the url-action grammar that landed as objectstack `9b37edbd7` (`http(s)://`, `mailto:`, in-app `/…` or `./…`). The renderer's `classifyNavigationTarget` answers the same set.
- **objectstack-ai/objectstack#23005:** a `type: 'list'` page's `InterfacePageConfigSchema` gains an optional `emptyState` of that same `EmptyStateSchema`.

The exact key names land with the objectstack PR. Read them from the spec at the version that carries them, not from this card.

## The renderer work (objectui `origin/main` `5dcb101`)

1. **`packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`**, the empty branch near L5689: it reads `schema.emptyState?.title` / `message` / `icon` only. Draw the declared link through the action runner's navigation, the same `classifyNavigationTarget` answer, beside or instead of the add-record button, as the spec's restated guidance says.
2. **`packages/app-shell/src/views/InterfaceListPage.tsx:503`** passes `emptyState: view.emptyState` only. Prefer the page's own `interfaceConfig.emptyState` over a source view's, on every visualization. The gallery half of this, objectstack-ai/objectui#12217, is closed.

## Order

This card waits on the objectstack PR for objectstack-ai/objectstack#23004 + #23005 (one fold, dispatched now), then on a spec release this repository can install.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, closed included, for `empty state link action ListView DataEmptyState emptyState action button docs link`: 1 hit. That hit, #7143 (closed), is the error-state finding, a different question.
